question: Approve DRC-4604's triage: fix the pre-existing .next-session-copy defect here, and confirm the four scope rulings?

artifacts.summary: An independent census at 21a0e93 finds 14 control selectors declaring a non-zero radius or resting border, decomposing exactly into the primitive (1), exempt (7), a text input (1) and these five - so the five are confirmed while the issue's headline 24 rules reproduces at neither tree and is demoted to a dated history section. Two composed facts no per-rule reading shows, resolved through tests/css_cascade.py: 4 of the 6 shipped .next-action class combinations reach the promised 15px and the 2 carrying .next-session-copy reach 11.5px; and the exempt .next-session-raise renders 6px/11px inside .next-rail-wait-controls against 3px/11.5px outside it, because one of the five rules being removed outranks it on tag count - so the removal is not purely subtractive. The blocker relation is stale: DRC-4590 merged as 21a0e93 mid-triage, and the live blocker is DRC-4602 on the same stylesheet and the same byte pins. Seven ACs resolve under --ac-scan. Noted for anyone building on the resolver: matches() counts ids without checking them, reporting 14px from #app for every button.
